image_description: A close-up macro shot of a brown butterfly, identified as a Ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on a green leaf. The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is characterized by a uniform brown color and a row of distinct eyespots (ocelli) with white centers and yellow rings along the hindwing margin. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green.
